directions.name: Linen
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-resolution landscape UI art-direction board, approximately 2560 x 1700. This is one of five ORIGINAL visual directions for Hermes Studio, the user's standalone bots-first AI workspace. Make a realistic, buildable premium interface with impeccable typography, readable controls, strong hierarchy and original avatars.
INPUT REFERENCES: image 1 is the ACTUAL current Bots roster; image 2 is the ACTUAL Echo bot profile; image 3 is the ACTUAL Echo chat welcome. These are functional and product-content references, not style targets. Redesign those real screens; replace the dark rock character and current violet frosted styling completely. Preserve product name, bot identities/roles and core navigation. The black native server-switching toolbar is app chrome and should not be reproduced as a large strip.
BOARD: refined design-presentation layout on a solid coordinated background. A narrow top label gives concept number/name and "Hermes Studio". Under it show THREE clearly separate straight-on application screenshots, with no perspective, device photography or overlapping windows. Large desktop Echo chat takes roughly left 64%; right column has a compact Bots roster screen above a compact Echo profile screen. Labels above each panel: "01 / CHAT", "02 / BOTS", "03 / PROFILE". Bottom identity strip shows the FOUR new avatar family members named "Atlas", "Nova", "Scout", "Echo", plus tiny 28px/48px samples so we can judge practical icon legibility. Main interface is the focus, not a mascot poster. Keep panels large, aligned, with careful whitespace, not a dense moodboard.
PRODUCT CONTENT: main chat has compact navigation with "Dashboard", "Bots", "Team rooms", "Routines", "Settings", and persistent teammate roster. Header "Echo", "Writing partner", status "Ready". Center shows ONE friendly new Echo character above "Say hello to Echo", subtext "A focused teammate for clear, useful writing." Two starter prompts "Plan my week" and "Shape an idea". Bottom composer "Message Echo…" with attachment, microphone, send controls and a quiet model chip. Optional restrained right context column with "Memory", "Files", "Skills", "Teammates". Roster screen "Bots", "+ New bot", four distinct teammates "Atlas / Chief of staff", "Nova / Creative partner", "Scout / Research analyst", "Echo / Writing partner"; use compact practical cards or rows with textual "Ready" status. Profile screen Echo hero, "Open chat", tabs "Overview", "Brain", "Memory", "Files", tidy capability summary. No charts/analytics invented for filler, no fabricated task successes, no source screenshot error text.
AVATAR PRINCIPLES: a coherent family of FOUR genuinely distinguishable silhouettes, each with two relaxed level dark eyes and gentle welcoming expression. They should read as capable approachable teammates, not threatening robots or baby toys. Consistent character across avatar strip and UI for each name. Eye geometry never slants inward into a scowl. Use portraits/simple silhouettes at 28px and 48px, reserve a larger character for the chat welcome/profile. No graphite armor, black visors, glowing orange eyes, heavy hood, horns, sharp teeth, sneakers, props, or intricate costumes. No Grok/OpenBot characters, logos or copied brand marks. Borrow only the product ideas of a recognizable team and calm ongoing presence.
Ensure legible high-contrast text. Maintain disciplined alignment and realistic UI proportions. Finish as an exceptional designer's final interface proposal, not wireframes or promotional website.
DIRECTION 01 / LINEN — warm editorial ceramic.
Palette warm ivory #F6F1E8, charcoal ink #302F2C, quiet apricot #DB8865, soft sage and dusty mauve as supporting identity colors. Warm near-white page with subtly translucent parchment sidebar, flat paper panels, very fine sand borders and exceptionally restrained soft shadows. Interface typography uses an elegant contemporary editorial serif ONLY for the welcome title, clean humanist sans elsewhere. Compact sidebar and generous chat width; tactile small apricot send control, quiet text tabs, simple outline icons, warm professional studio atmosphere. Original Hermes Studio brand mark is a minimal paired arch in ink, discreet.
AVATARS: satin glazed ceramic abstract companions, physically smooth and softly irregular, no robot masks: Atlas is an ivory round pebble, Nova a peach asymmetrical arch, Scout a sage bean, Echo a lilac rounded capsule. Faces are dark small level oval eyes, tiny subtle smile in the same light body material without a face panel. Soft natural studio light, almost no specular shine. Make them both elegant and lovable, with a characteristic slight off-center seam or tiny dimple. The whole board feels like a thoughtfully designed personal creative studio, not generic pastel SaaS.

DIRECTION 02 / TIDE — precise sea-glass calm.
Palette pearl white #F3F8F7, deep ocean ink #173C45, sea-glass teal #2E8C8D, restrained aqua and pale periwinkle. Bright airy surfaces with localized translucent glass panels; thin luminous edge only at one active region, generous clear center and restrained depth. Use a narrower icon navigation rail paired with a compact teammate list, distinctive horizontal teal active indicator, clean rounded grotesk typography. Status text with small teal dot, softly recessed composer, pill-sized action controls. Roster rows look like tidy docked companions rather than huge cards. Original Hermes Studio mark is two offset flowing arcs.
AVATARS: translucent frosted sea-glass sculptures in four distinctive smooth shapes: Atlas pale-aqua soft square pebble, Nova clear lilac folded loop, Scout seafoam bean, Echo mist-blue smooth arch. Two visible embedded charcoal eyes and tiny relaxed smile, not a dark face screen. One suspended colored ribbon inside each body gives identity. Light enters from upper left; edges clean and legible at 28px, no excessive glossy reflections, no chrome. The UI and characters share a tactile material language without becoming glass decoration. Fresh, coastal, serene, unmistakably digital.

DIRECTION 03 / FOLD — bold graphic working studio.
Palette crisp warm-white #FAFAF6, nearly black #202326, vivid cobalt #315AF2, accents coral, ochre and leaf green. This direction should look structurally DIFFERENT from soft glass: very crisp flat surfaces, fine dark ink rules, modest 10–14px corner radii, no gradients or blur, strong clean typography and selective large serif welcome title. Compact structured workspace with a strong vertical team roster, clear cobalt selection band, document-like chat canvas, precisely aligned left labels. Use a tiny original folded-H brand symbol. A deliberately modern graphic design sensibility with human warmth, restrained Bauhaus/editorial influence.
AVATARS: entirely FLAT vector-like illustrated folded-paper characters with subtly imperfect thick ink outlines, two simple dot eyes and tiny curved mouth. FOUR radically different but cohesive silhouettes: Atlas cobalt rounded folded triangle, Nova coral open loop/arch, Scout leaf-green scalloped bean, Echo ochre paper ribbon knot. Each has one subtle visible fold, never hard sharp tips; no 3D rendering, shadows, clay, glossy gradients or robot heads. Must remain iconic and friendly when tiny. Keep UI white and quiet so the four graphic identities carry personality. Most independent and memorable brand in the set.

DIRECTION 04 / BLOOM — a living botanical workspace.
Palette soft oat #F3F0E4, forest ink #24493E, moss #638773, terracotta #BD7861, pale butter and lilac. Premium warm Scandinavian feeling, organic lightly tinted section surfaces with 20px corners and thin calm borders, humanist sans typography, no decorative leaves filling background. Unlike a conventional SaaS sidebar, organize the main chat with a slim top navigation and a HORIZONTAL teammate switcher showing the four distinct avatars, plus a small tucked navigation column. Provide breathable writing space and a beautifully simple forest-green composer action. Profile uses clean ruled sections rather than many mini dashboard cards. Original Hermes Studio emblem is a two-part seed shape.
AVATARS: satin seed/bud companions, four abstract solid forms that feel alive and grounded, not literal plants in pots. Atlas broad sage seed with a tiny single crown notch; Nova peach twin-lobed bud; Scout butter-yellow rounded sprout with one small off-center leaf detail; Echo lilac soft bean with a small curled edge. Kind open level ink eyes and tiny relaxed mouths, smooth tactile surfaces, softly lit. Elegant friendly creatures, no limbs needed, no big baby eyes, no pots, no gardening props. Cohesive organic silhouette system at 28px with subtle material depth; visually warmer and more earthly than Tide or Linen.

DIRECTION 05 / DUSK — quiet evening, luminous companions.
A true DARK design unlike the other four: midnight plum #221F2C background, slightly lighter aubergine #2D2938 panels, warm chalk #F2EEE7 text, subdued lavender #AAA1D2, peach #E7A58C action. Refined high contrast typography, extremely subtle localized lavender glass, quiet hairline borders and soft warm pools of light. No pure black, neon, busy stars or sci-fi gradients. Narrow quiet left nav and a team roster with luminous portrait tiles. Central Echo chat is an expansive soft charcoal writing surface with beautiful readable text; composer a gently elevated dark pill/rounded rectangle. Roster uses four horizontal dark rows with pale small avatars. Original Hermes Studio mark is an incomplete soft orbit with two dots, understated.
AVATARS: pale softly luminous opal abstract companions that contrast clearly against dark UI. Atlas warm ivory moon pebble; Nova soft pink rounded four-lobed star; Scout pale mint rounded arch; Echo lavender cloud/loop. Same two dark level eyes and a subtle gentle smile, no black masks or glowing eyes. Pearlescent satin finish with contained glow only at silhouette edge; tiny icons stay sharp. Mood feels secure, intimate, sophisticated and approachable, not cyberpunk or gamer aesthetic. Show both card-size avatars and the 28px portraits to prove they stay friendly in a dark interface.
